snippet.title: Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Buckle up for the ultimate arcade racing experience where high-speed action meets explosive vehicular combat across wild extraterrestrial tracks! 🔥

In the galaxy’s most dangerous tournament, only one racer can claim the title of Galactic Champion. Do you have what it takes?

👾 Inspired by retro classics, Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown brings back the thrill of old-school racing with:
💥 Intense combat mechanics
🎮 Stylized visuals
🎶 Heart-pounding synthwave soundtrack
🌌 And unforgettable alien worlds!
 
✨ WISHLIST NOW on Steam and be the first to hit the tracks on launch day:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2475170/Cosmic_Race_Galactic_Showdown/

 
🌍 Follow us for exclusive content, behind-the-scenes, and updates!
